clue.text: IST

parts.note: the three letters are printed in upper-case type, so they are literally put in capital form

explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is a picture: the letters IST set in capitals, i.e. CAPITAL + IST. A capitalist is someone who invests capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A capitalist is an investor of money, and the picture of letters set in upper case gives the same word in two parts.

clue.text: Argument in cabinet

definitions.meaning: a lawyer's argument or line of reasoning
a glass display cabinet in a museum or shop

explanation.definitionFit: A legal argument is a case, and a display cabinet is a glass case.

clue.text: Stop a number going in, as usual

indicators.note: the phrase says these pieces enter the other word and sit within it

parts.note: to stop something is to prevent it
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone tries to block a number from entering, as they always do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stop' is the verb to block, not a halt; 'as' is only a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: What is prevalent is widespread and common, the normal state of things.

clue.text: Get thinner and lighter

definitions.meaning: to narrow gradually towards one end
a wax-coated wick used to light candles or gas

explanation.definitionFit: Something that narrows gradually tapers, and a slender spill used to light things is a taper.

clue.text: Goes ahead when the dogs are ready for a walk

definitions.meaning: takes the front position and guides others

definitions.text: when the dogs are ready for a walk
definitions.meaning: the dogs have their straps clipped to their collars

explanation.definitionFit: A guide who goes in front does this, and dogs with straps clipped on for a walk have them attached.

clue.text: Cup-holders?

parts.note: the hyphenated phrase suggests trophy holders or brassieres, but means the small dishes a teacup stands on

explanation.definitionFit: Small dishes placed under teacups literally hold the cups.

clue.text: Samuel's teacher has a name for writing essays

parts.note: in the Bible the boy Samuel was raised and taught by the priest Eli

explanation.surface: The tutor of a biblical prophet has a pen name under which essays are written.
explanation.walkthrough: Charles Lamb published his Essays of Elia under this pen name.
explanation.definitionFit: Elia was the pseudonym Charles Lamb used for his collected essays.

clue.text: They pride themselves in their family

definitions.text: They pride themselves in their family

parts.words: They pride themselves in their family
parts.note: a family group of these big cats is called a pride, so they are literally a pride

explanation.definitionFit: A family group of these big cats is called a pride.

clue.text: They are named for the post

definitions.text: They are named for the post

parts.words: They are named for the post
parts.note: sounds like candidates nominated for a job, but means people whose names go on letters

explanation.definitionFit: The people whose names are written on letters and parcels are the intended recipients.

clue.text: A brief way to encourage a caviare supplier

parts.note: St is the short form of Street, a kind of way
to urge on is to spur someone forward

explanation.surface: A quick way to coax a merchant into selling more fish eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Caviar is the salted roe of this large fish.

clue.text: Clean up in a gamble

definitions.meaning: to brush a floor or chimney clean
short for sweepstake, a lottery on a race where the winner takes all

explanation.definitionFit: Brushing a floor clean is to do this, and a sweepstake bet is a shortened form of the same word.

clue.text: A fully developed state

parts.note: sounds like a mature nation, but means the grown-up stage of life

explanation.definitionFit: Being grown up is the stage of life at which a person is fully mature.

clue.text: Such intricate patterns are just a tissue of lies

parts.note: fair means just or impartial

indicators.note: a tissue is a woven fabric, so the following word is woven into a new order

explanation.surface: Elaborate knitwear designs are dismissed as nothing but a web of falsehoods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a tissue of' weaves LIES into ISLE. Fair Isle is a Shetland island famous for multicoloured patterned knitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair Isle is a style of multicoloured knitting with intricate repeating bands.

clue.text: Stood up to embrace one girl

indicators.note: the first piece wraps its arms round the second, holding it inside

parts.note: rose means stood up
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone got to their feet to hug a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosie is a girl's first name.

clue.text: Don't remain wholly calm?

parts.note: losing composure is pictured as no longer staying in one piece

explanation.definitionFit: To lose one's composure completely is to fall apart into fragments, figuratively.

clue.text: Ended series, having exceeded time allowed

parts.note: over means ended or finished
a run is a series, as of wins

explanation.surface: A sequence of events came to a close after going past its deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: Going past the allotted time is to exceed it.

clue.text: Crossword addicts should be used to such a set-back

definitions.text: Crossword addicts should be used to such a set-back

parts.words: Crossword addicts should be used to such a set-back
parts.note: a set-back is a misfortune, but solvers know clues that tell them to read a word backwards

explanation.definitionFit: A setback is a reverse of fortune, and solvers often meet words to be read backwards.

clue.text: Chooses not to go straight?

parts.note: suggests a criminal refusing to reform, but means veering off a direct line

explanation.definitionFit: Veering sharply off a direct course is the literal sense of declining to go straight.

clue.text: He bows both during and after his recital

definitions.text: He bows both during and after his recital

parts.words: He bows both during and after his recital
parts.note: the performer bows to the audience at the end and draws a bow across strings while playing

explanation.definitionFit: A string player draws a bow while playing and takes a bow at the end.

clue.text: A short month on a Roman road for Antony's wife

parts.note: Oct is the abbreviation for October
via is the Latin word for road, as in the Via Appia

explanation.surface: Travelling a Roman highway briefly one month, looking for Mark Antony's spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: Octavia, sister of Octavian, was the wife of Mark Antony.
explanation.definitionFit: Octavia, sister of Augustus, married Mark Antony in 40 BC.

clue.text: Checks, made by police

definitions.meaning: seizures of suspects carried out by officers

explanation.definitionFit: Halting progress is one sense, and police taking suspects into custody is the other.

clue.text: A cheater cheated? Turn a blind eye!

parts.note: a con, short for con man, is a swindler
done means swindled, as in 'I've been done'

explanation.surface: A swindler has been swindled himself, so look the other way.
explanation.definitionFit: To overlook an offence is to pretend not to see it, forgiving it tacitly.

clue.text: Company doctor is amusing when in theatre

parts.note: a medic is a doctor

explanation.surface: A firm's physician turns out to be funny on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Comedic describes stage work belonging to comedy, meant to make audiences laugh.

clue.text: Make a deduction

parts.note: sounds like subtracting money, but means drawing a conclusion

explanation.definitionFit: To conclude something by reasoning from evidence is to deduce it.

clue.text: Feel like something a bit extravagant?

definitions.meaning: to want or desire, as in 'do you want a drink?'
elaborate or ornate rather than plain

explanation.definitionFit: To want something is to desire it, and an ornate or showy item is elaborate.

clue.text: Sentimental jerk in Italy?

parts.note: something from the capital of Italy is Roman
a tic is an involuntary twitch or jerk

explanation.surface: A soppy idiot living on the Italian peninsula.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jerk' looks like an insult for a fool; it is a twitch, a Roman one.
explanation.definitionFit: Romantic means given to sentiment and idealised feelings.

clue.text: I complain when she turns up

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: to moan is to complain

explanation.surface: A grumbler protests whenever a certain woman arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reads I MOAN backwards. Naomi is a woman's name, and Ruth's mother-in-law in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi is a female name, so a woman referred to by a pronoun.

clue.text: Dispatch a snow vehicle, we hear

indicators.note: the phrase says the word is heard spoken rather than seen written

parts.note: a sleigh is a sledge pulled over snow

explanation.surface: Send off a sledge, so it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispatch someone is to kill them.

clue.text: Found out people's feelings about sand and caves

indicators.note: the word means around and is used here to say the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: Someone researched public opinion on beaches and grottoes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges SAND and CAVES; 'and' only joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: Canvassing means asking people their opinions, as before an election.

clue.text: Oxford college window

definitions.meaning: one of the colleges of Oxford University
a projecting bay window on an upper floor

explanation.definitionFit: There is a college at Oxford of this name, and a bay projecting from an upper storey has the same name.

clue.text: Small yet troublesome inflammation

indicators.note: the word suggests the letters are unruly and have got out of order

explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid.

clue.text: A subject for those who have a mind to study

definitions.text: A subject for those who have a mind to study

parts.words: A subject for those who have a mind to study
parts.note: having a mind to do something means wanting to, but here it is the mind they study

explanation.definitionFit: The medical study of mental illness is a field for those who study the mind.
